title: Bug turns one of the biggest fears about Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses into reality
gist: Some Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses recorded conversations without the 'Hey, Meta' prompt, a bug Meta says is fixed without explaining the cause or scale. Ars Technica argues the incident validates long-standing fears of nonconsensual recording, alongside Sama contractor footage reports, a US class action, a Texas AG probe and a possible Norwegian ban.
